summary: Practise climate-risk assessment, register design and continuity planning. Explore the five-day foundation course and its practical outputs.
lede: Climate risk management connects climate hazards and transition drivers to risk registers, controls and continuity decisions. For risk officers, resilience leads and operational managers, the training covers screening exposure, assessing vulnerability, scoring risks and building a climate risk register with owners and treatment actions, using concepts from ISO 31000 and ISO 14091. It also addresses monitoring indicators, escalation triggers and concise updates for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who identify climate-related threats, maintain risk controls or report resilience decisions across operational and strategic teams.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with operational risk registers is useful. No climate-science or coding background is required.
